No — that Bay Auto Pages info is outdated and wrong on both price and Sunday. The business's own site controls.

- Bay Auto Pages says flat $129 full detail, open Sundays, boat detailing, ceramic coating. That listing is unclaimed and last updated March 2023.
- Cormorant's own site and booking rules say:
  - Full detail = The Schooner (everything in exterior + interior + spray wax) — Starting at $219, not flat $129. Your 2018 Corolla is Class A / small.
  - So base $219 + 8.625% tax = $237.89 total in 94121, with $0 travel fee. $50 deposit counts toward total. I ran a live quote: $219 + $0 travel + $18.89 tax = $237.89.
  - They work Tuesday-Saturday only, closed Sunday and Monday. Office Mon-Sat 8am-6pm. This Sunday Nov 8, 2026 cannot be booked — quote tool returns "The business is closed on Sundays."
  - They also do NOT do boats or ceramic coating.

If you want a full detail at home in 94121, nearest open window in the calendar is Saturday Nov 7 morning (adds $25 Saturday fee, so ($219+$25)*1.08625 = ~$265.05), then Tuesday Nov 10 afternoon, etc. Sunday is not available.
